searched: The build's own files, read on 2026-10-17: CREDITS.md, LICENSE, licenses/three-LICENSE.txt, licenses/polyhaven-CC0.txt and every source file's header; and the second park's asset record (sources/props/README.md in the source tree, outside the build), whose seven Poly Haven assets were checked against Poly Haven's own API (author, and the md5 and size of each file used) and its licence page. Every model, texture and sound of the game, and both parks' layouts, are made by the game's own code when it starts, except Kiln Yard's buildings and props, which are two model files (assets/kilnyard_backdrop.glb, assets/kilnyard_props.glb) built by our own Blender script from those seven CC0 models. The only code not written for this game is three.js 0.183.1 with three of its examples (MIT, licenses/three-LICENSE.txt) and the NotesMosaic port kit (MIT-0).
mine: All of Waxline but the seven CC0 source models below: its code, both parks (the Plaza and Kiln Yard), the skater, the board, every surface and every sound, written for this game by the owner's own Claude agent sessions in the NotesMosaic house studio (Mosaic); and the work of turning the seven models into Kiln Yard's buildings and props.
